title: Handling Fee Schedule for Web Hosting Plans Auto-Renew Refunds
content:
**Web Hosting Plans — handling fee kept back on an auto-renew refund**

The auto-renew refund amount keeps back a handling fee that depends on the whole calendar days from the refunded line's charge date to today:

| Whole calendar days from the charge date to today | Handling fee kept back |
|---|---|
| 3 days or fewer | nothing |
| more than 3 and up to 9 days | USD 9.00 |
| more than 9 days | USD 19.00 |

**Boundary days (hypothetical charge date 12 October).**

| Today | Days | Handling fee |
|---|---|---|
| 15 October | 3 | nothing |
| 16 October | 4 | USD 9.00 |
| 21 October | 9 | USD 9.00 |
| 22 October | 10 | USD 19.00 |
